why: The same room's upkeep of the mark and its running reports of the mark being damaged both read as watching the logo, and the gate turns on whether the fixing leads or only the telling does.

why.T3-021: The concepts are the routine upkeep of the mark - cleaning stray pixels, repairing the U, taking maintenance shifts, holding the logo and handing the watch on - with no attack call answered (so not T3-005) and with fixing rather than only telling (so not T3-073).

why.T3-073: These concepts tell what is happening to the mark that stands - eaten by blue, trashed in five minutes, under attack, gone - with no repair act (so not T3-021) and no build progress reported (so not T3-038).

why.T3-016: The single concept explains the event itself to someone out of the loop - the canvas, the timer, subs collaborating on a logo and fending off messers - which is T3-016's gate, not a guide to the room's own coordinates (T3-070).

why.T3-017: Visiting fans are received over ordinary hockey matters - cheering Talbot, a 1994 joke, where to watch, bars near Rogers Place - the sub's usual subject going on with no canvas work in it, which is T3-017's gate.

why.T3-002: The doing is calling the room's own people in to place, start, fix and hold the Cubs logo - 'who's in', 'all hands on deck', 'defend the logo' - with coordinates only as the address of the call, so T3-002 rather than T3-070 or T3-005.

why.T3-021: A damaged letter in the banner is spotted and fixed, the repeated u-to-o change is described and defence of it is called for - watching and repairing the work kept intact, which is T3-021 rather than the joke styling of T3-023.

why.T3-016: The passages work out the event itself for newcomers - what r/place is, a pixel every five minutes, how to click and place, explaining it again in the thread - which is T3-016's gate; the spot and relocation concepts are where the explained work is put, not the doing.

why.T3-017: A hockey edit celebrating Talbot tying the wins record with the room's DADBOT name - ordinary sub talk on its usual subject with no canvas work in it, which is T3-017's gate.

why.T3-029: Loss is the leading note: the logo never recovered, RIP, booted out, the proud logo did not survive - grief for the room's work once placement ended, which is T3-029 rather than the plain account of T3-073 or the blame of T3-058.

why.T3-027: The bulk of the concepts argue the fairness of scripts - defeating the purpose, messaging the mods, the IP block and whether it was deserved - which is T3-027's gate, and the argument leads over the running.
why.T3-028: A distinct concept has a member actually making a script that maintains the Oilers logo, an act of running a script for the room's work that the argument theme cannot carry.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-027's gate reaches the argument over whether scripts are fair but not the room's actual making of a maintenance script, which is T3-028's doing.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1057687 has a member making a script that maintains the Oilers logo - a script made and run for the room's work, which is T3-028's gate and not an argument about fairness.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-028: dropping it loses the record that after the argument the room went on to build a maintenance script.

why.T3-073: The same running status of the mark that stands - eaten by blue, trashed, under attack, gone, bad again - told rather than fixed (not T3-021) and not build progress (not T3-038).

why.T3-010: The leading doing is settling lines and space with neighbours - a deal struck with r/Coldplay and a move to (0,362), permission for the cat feet, a deal not to touch the artwork around the logo, expansion steered right past the cat people - which is T3-010's gate rather than a standing alliance (T3-150) or a case-by-case swap of help (T3-151).

why.T3-030: The codes dispute how the Calgary collaboration went - renouncing it in anger, justifying why it had been necessary, questioning how long a member worked on the Flames logo, limiting how much was defended - an alliance's conduct and worth judged, which is T3-030 and not a breach invoked mid-work (T3-195).

why.T3-004: The concepts work out the mark's look and correct it against the plan - hijacking the red C, exact dimensions, moving the U inside the C, single-square UBS, white borders, a circular logo, the W flag and 2016 shifted - which is settling the design (T3-004) rather than proposing the mark (T3-033) or extending with new pieces (T3-041).

why.T3-017: Memeing in the Off Day Talk - keeping the sabbath memey, persisting with a shitpost through removal and ban - is the sub's ordinary humour going on with no canvas work in it, which is T3-017 rather than the room's jokes played around the canvas (T3-031).
